intro: Darkcore the Elder is a seasonal quest encountered during the Lunar Festival within the Undercity. By seeking out Elder Darkcore, travelers pay homage to the ancient spirits honored across Azeroth and receive a Coin of Ancestry in return.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, friend, and offer you this token...
